name: ste
description: Write or rewrite English prose to ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Includes a deterministic checker script and a PostToolUse hook that feeds violations back to Claude in the same turn.

auto_check.title: Automatic STE check
auto_check.description: Run the STE checker each time Claude writes or edits a Markdown file, and feed the violations back to Claude. Off by default. When off, you use /ste and the checker script manually.
